title: Almost Vanilla!
description: A vanilla++ modpack custom-tailored for performance, looks and nice functions, quality of life enhancements.
body:
A custom modpack that is my default come to on a daily basis.

I made this pack to enhance the vanilla experience with small additions that I find nice to have in the game. 

## Mods affecting quality of life:

1. [AppleSkin by squeek502](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) which adds various food-related HUD improvements.
1. [Atmosfera by Fourmisain](https://modrinth.com/mod/atmosfera) is a client-side ambient sound system with customizable, atmospheric sound resources.
1. [Bigger Stack Size by Jodek](https://modrinth.com/mod/bigger-stack-size) makes all items that are normally stackable up to 1 or 16 are now stackable up to 64.
1. [Blastproof by Barenton](https://modrinth.com/mod/blastproof) ensures explosions from TNT, creepers, end crystals, and other sources won't damage your hard work.
1. [Bridging Mod by CG360](https://modrinth.com/mod/bridging-mod) adds a bridging assist feature often referred to as "Reach-Around Placement" for Forge, Fabric, & Quilt! It's very similar to features found in both Minecraft: Bedrock Edition & the Quark mod, taking the best parts from both.
1. [Client Sort by TerminalMC](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort) is a client-side inventory sorting mod with keybind and GUI support.
1. [Clumps by jaredlll08](https://modrinth.com/mod/clumps) groups XP orbs together into a single entity to reduce lag when there are many in a small area.
1. [Cut Through by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/cut-through) allows you to swing your weapon through tall grass and all other blocks without a collision shape when fighting an enemy.
1. [Day Dream by SmushyTaco](https://modrinth.com/mod/day-dream) allows you to sleep during the day to make it night.
1. [Durability Tooltip by SuperMartijn642](https://modrinth.com/mod/durability-tooltip) shows you the durability of items!
1. [Eclipse's Tweakeroo Additions by eclipseisoffline](https://modrinth.com/mod/eclipses-tweakeroo-additions) is a modular utility mod for Minecraft. It contains various tweaks and modifications, all of which can be configured and toggled to your liking. 
1. [FallingTree by Rakambda](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingtree) will change the way you break trees.
1. [Glowing Torchflower by NikitaCartes](https://modrinth.com/mod/glowing-torchflower) makes Torchflower glow in dark.
1. [Hide Experimental Warning by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/hide-experimental-warning) as the name suggests, hides the experimental settings warning when creating or loading a modded world.
1. [I'm Fast by Bielhiss](https://modrinth.com/mod/im-fast) is a modern solution to remove minecraft "moved too quickly" and "moved wrongly" using mixin.
1. [Infinite Trading by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/infinite-trading) is a minimalistic mod which prevents villager trades from locking up, making them always available and allowing infinite trading.
1. [Item Scroller by masa](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-scroller) is a mod that adds several more convenient ways of moving items inside inventory screens.
1. [Jade 🔍 by Snownee](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) is the information HUD mod - Hwyla/Waila for modern Minecraft versions. Designed for better user experience and API.
1. [Kelp Fertilizer by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/kelp-fertilizer) makes kelp act exactly like bone meal. This works both when a player right-clicks a crop and when used in a dispenser.
1. [Learn From Your Deeds! by MephistoPheles666](https://modrinth.com/mod/learn-from-your-deeds!) lets you get experience via alternative ways!
1. [Leash Villager by Nico4play](https://modrinth.com/mod/leash-villager) makes villagers leashable.
1. [Logical Efficient Tools by TheGreatOwlMaster](https://modrinth.com/mod/logical-efficient-tools) aims to fix certain blocks, most notably glass, glowstone, honeycomb blocks and froglights, that don't have tools associated to them by giving every one of those blocks an associated tool, excluding blocks that aren't meant to be broken, like reinforced deepslate, trial spawners and vaults, as well as blocks that are always instantly broken, like honey blocks and blocks of resin.
1. [More Mouse Tweaks by TerminalMC](https://modrinth.com/mod/moremousetweaks) Complements Mouse Tweaks by adding more mouse functionality from Mouse Wheelie.
1. [Mouse Tweaks by YaLTeR](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) replaces the standard RMB dragging mechanic, adds two new LMB dragging mechanics and an ability to quickly move items with the scroll wheel.
1. [Nemo's Mending by DevNemo](https://modrinth.com/mod/nemos-mending) repairs not only your mending tools in your equipment slot, but every mending tool in your inventory!
1. [Nemo's Night Progression by DevNemo](https://modrinth.com/mod/nemos-night-progression) makes the world keep progressing while you sleep. Sleeping no longer just skips the night - instead, it simulates the time that would have passed.
1. [Nicer Portals by Roundaround](https://modrinth.com/mod/nicer-portals) adds various small improvements to portals.
1. [No Chat Reports by Aizistral](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) strips cryptographic signatures which are attached to every chat message sent from 1.19 and onwards. Removing them makes it impossible to track and associate your chat messages with your Minecraft client, and, by extension, Microsoft account.
1. [No Enderman Grief by Jodek](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-enderman-grief) stops endermen from pickung up blocks.
1. [No Resource Pack Warnings by Space Walker](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-resource-pack-warnings) gets rid of the scary red borders around outdated resource/data packs and skip those pesky pop up warnings when applying them.
1. [Panda Lead Break by TreeOfSelf](https://modrinth.com/mod/pandaleadbreak) makes leads strong enough to pull entities while flying around on the elytra.
1. [Recycle Blast by meenimc](https://modrinth.com/mod/recycle-blast) adds recipes for scrapping metal armor pieces, horse armors, tools, and rails.
1. [RightClickHarvest by Jam Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/rightclickharvest) allows harvesting crops and plants with just a right click.
1. [SilkTouch+ by Wheeler-Shigley](https://modrinth.com/mod/silktouch+) makes many blocks silk-touch-able and configurable with gamerules.
1. [Sound Controller by BVengo](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-controller) provides complete volume control over the sounds played in the game. It adds an extra set of options to your sound settings, providing you with volume sliders for every single sound between 0-200%.
1. [Sound Physics Remastered by henkelmax](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.
1. [Stonecutter Damage by un_pogaz](https://modrinth.com/mod/stonecutter-damage) inflicts 1 point damage (half-heart) to creature walks on it.
1. [Sword Blocking Mechanics by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/sword-blocking-mechanics)  restores the very useful blocking ability to all swords straight from the Minecraft 1.7 / 1.8 combat era.
1. [Tax Free Levels by Fourmisain](https://modrinth.com/mod/tax-free-levels) flattens the curve of the ever-increasing anvil and enchantment costs , meaning you'll always pay the same amount of XP, regardless of how high your level gets. It by default also removes the "Too Expensive!" anvil limit and makes it so that renaming an item always only costs 1 level.
1. [Text Formatting Everywhere by Potat369](https://modrinth.com/mod/text-formatting-everywhere) Removes restriction in typing section sign (§), therefore you can use formatting codes to format text everywhere!
1. [The Butcher's Nails by MephistoPheles666](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-butchers-nails) makes it so all living creatures those otherwise have skin and it makes sense to drop leather, now do drop leather. They also drop bone. Villagers included.
1. [TweakerMore by fallen-breath](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakermore) is a collection of client-side tweak kits for enhance your Minecraft game experience. Everything is disabled by default.
1. [Tweakeroo by masa](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo) is a client-side mod that adds a whole bunch of miscellaneous "tweaks" to the game.
1. [Uncraft Everything by CoolerProYT](https://modrinth.com/mod/uncraft-everything) adds a uncrafting mechanic to Minecraft, allowing players to take crafted items and break them back down into their original components.
1. [Veinminer by Miraculixx](https://modrinth.com/mod/veinminer)  is a common feature in various modpacks or survival pvp game modes like UHC to speed up breaking whole veins.
1. [Veinminer Hotkey by Miraculixx](https://modrinth.com/mod/veinminer-client) is an addon for the popular Veinminer mod/plugin that adds a custom hotkey and veinmine preview. As long as this addon is installed, veinmining is only possible with the hotkey pressed (still respecting block rules and settings).
1. [Very Many Players (Fabric) by ishland](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric) is designed to improve server performance at high playercounts.
1. [Villager Names by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-names-serilum) gives all unnamed villagers a pre-defined name. This will name old and new spawns in the world.
1. [Wall-Jump TXF by jahirtrap](https://modrinth.com/mod/wall-jump-txf) adds wall jump, double jump, fence jump & more.
1. [Xaero's Minimap by thexaero](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) is a minimap that keeps the aesthetic of vanilla Minecraft, which helps it be a more seamless addition to the game. It is also the first rotating square minimap for Minecraft.
1. [Xaero's World Map by thexaero](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) adds a self-writing fullscreen map to your Minecraft client. Works as a separate mod but is a lot better with Xaero's Minimap.
1. [XaeroPlus by rfresh2](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeroplus) is a client-side Minecraft mod that depends on and modifies the Xaero's WorldMap and Minimap mods with extra features and performance improvements - particularly for use on anarchy servers like 2b2t.
1. [Zoomify by isxander](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) aims to provide the easiest, most configurable and most sexy looking zoom mod you will ever find.

## Mods affecting visuals:

1. [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined by EminGT](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) is a shader pack for Minecraft Java Edition with exceptional attention to detail, high standards of quality, and top tier optimisation. It offers a ton of high quality effects, two default visual style choices, custom effects for almost every block in the game, profiles ranging from Potato to Ultra and it's designed to never be obstructive during gameplay.
1. [Complementary Shaders - Unbound by EminGT](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound) comes with two distinct visual style options. The only difference between these two styles is the default settings. The Unbound style is designed for people looking for a more realistic experience, while the Reimagined style is made to reimagine Minecraft while preserving its unique visual elements.
1. [Iris Shaders by coderbot](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) is a modern shader pack loader for Minecraft intended to be compatible with existing OptiFine shader packs.
1. [MakeUp - Ultra Fast by KDXavier](https://modrinth.com/shader/makeup-ultra-fast-shaders) aims to provide the best quality / performance ratio, building a shader that can be adapted to anyone's resources. Build the shader you want! All the effects are optional!, and you will only consume the resources that you need.
1. [Photon Shaders by sixthsurge](https://modrinth.com/shader/photon-shader) is a gameplay-focused shader pack with a semi-realistic style.
1. [Solas Shader by Septonious](https://modrinth.com/shader/solas-shader) is a modern fantasy stylized Minecraft: Java Edition shaderpack aiming to provide stunning visuals at a moderate performance cost.
1. [Spooklementary by SpacEagle17](https://modrinth.com/shader/spooklementary) is a horror-themed shaderpack that transforms your game into a moody and spooky experience.
1. [Super Duper Vanilla by Eldeston](https://modrinth.com/shader/super-duper-vanilla) is a shader pack created to convey the style of the cancelled Super Duper Graphics Pack and other popular Minecraft titles.
1. [Visuality by PinkGoosik](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality) is a simple client-sided cosmetic mod that will add a bunch of new particles such as crystal sparkles, particles on mob hitting, custom blob particles for slimes, environmental particles to your Minecraft world.
1. [Mellow by TheCMK](https://modrinth.com/shader/mellow) is a shaderpack with a painterly aesthetic made for people who want to actually play the game. It's easy on your eyes and on your computer!

## Mods improving performance:

1. [BadOptimizations by thosea](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)is a collection of mostly micro optimizations that add up to something bigger!
1. [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric) by ishland](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) is a mod designed to improve the chunk performance of Minecraft.
1. [Debugify by isxander](https://modrinth.com/mod/debugify)  is a project that fixes over 70 bugs found on the bug tracker in Minecraft.
1. [Entity Culling by tr7zw](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) mod introduces asynchronous path-tracing to efficiently determine what's actually visible to the player. By leveraging multiple CPU cores, it calculates line-of-sight visibility in real-time and eliminates unnecessary draw calls for hidden block entities and entities.
1. [FerriteCore by malte0811](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) reduces the memory usage of Minecraft in a few different ways. A high-level technical description of the changes is available here.
1. [ImmediatelyFast by RaphiMC](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) is an open source Minecraft mod which improves the immediate mode rendering performance of the client.
1. It is designed to be lightweight and compatible with other mods.
1. [Lithium by CaffeineMC](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) is a modern, general-purpose optimization mod for Minecraft which works to improve a number of systems (game physics, mob AI, block ticking, etc) with the goal of not changing any vanilla mechanics.
1. [More Culling by FX](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling) is a mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance.
1. [Noisium by Steveplays](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisium) optimises worldgen performance for a better gameplay experience.
1. [Reese's Sodium Options by FlashyReese](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) is an Alternative Options Menu for Sodium.
1. [ScalableLux by ishland](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux) is mod based on Starlight that improves the performance of light updates in Minecraft. 
1. [Sodium by CaffeineMC](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) is a powerful optimization mod for the Minecraft client, which greatly improves frame rates and micro-stutter, while fixing many graphical issues in Minecraft. Unlike other rendering-focused mods, it boasts wide compatibility with the wider modding ecosystem. And it does so without compromising on how the game looks, giving you that authentic block game feel.
1. [Sodium Extra by FlashyReese](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) aims to bring most of OptiFine's eye-candy options to Sodium; in addition to providing some features such as visual bug fixes and other performance options that are not yet available on Sodium.
1. [Sodium Extra Information by anvian](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra-information) s a mod for Minecraft that adds extra information to the Sodium Extra mod. This mod is also a client-side mod, meaning that it only needs to be installed on the client side.
1. [ThreadTweak by getchoo](https://modrinth.com/mod/threadtweak) lets you improve and tweak Minecraft CPU scheduling. It is a maintained version of the original Smooth Boot mod, allowing you to still change CPU thread priorities in-game.

## Mods affecting gameplay:

1. [Amethyst Cutting by greenclaw](https://modrinth.com/mod/amethyst-cutting) lets you obtain Amethyst Clusters and Amethyst Buds by stonecutting Amethyst Blocks.
1. [Animal Feeding Trough by Slexom](https://modrinth.com/mod/animal_feeding_trough) lets you mobs self feed with feeding trough.
1. [Anvil Restoration by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/anvil-restoration) lets you repair placed anvils with iron ingots and damage them with obsidian.
1. [armored elytra v2.0.7 (MC 1.21-1.21.7).zip by vanillatweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks/) is a custom fork of the original made by me to add support for [Gilded Armor by BlockLegend001](https://modrinth.com/mod/gilded-armor).
1. [Chest Colorizer by kalucky0](https://modrinth.com/mod/chest-colorizer) lets you color-code your chests and barrels to easily distinguish between different types of items stored in them. With this mod, you can use a variety of dyes to assign a specific color to a chest, making it easy to identify what's inside with just a quick glance.
1. Craftable Ice and Stuff.zip is my custom made data pack from [[World Generator] Ocean Only Water World!](https://modrinth.com/datapack/world-generator-ocean-only-water-world!), keeping only the handy recipes added such as revitalizing corals, reverse crafting packed ice from blue ice, ice from packed ice and so on.
1. [Diagonal Fences by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/diagonal-fences) makes all kinds of fences able to connect diagonally.
1. [Easy Magic by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-magic) enables enchanting tables to retain their inventory contents even after closing the interface.
1. [Enchanted Vertical Slabs by enchanted-games](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchanted-vertical-slabs) is a simple, vanilla-like mod that adds vertical slabs to Minecraft.
1. [Enchantments Unbound by NotchArrow](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantments-unbound) makes a lot of things. Uncapped Enchantment Levels in the Anvil, No Too Expensive, and No Enchantment Conflicts.
1. [Gilded Armor by BlockLegend001](https://modrinth.com/mod/gilded-armor) Adds Gilded Armor, which makes piglin peaceful.
1. [Mo Glass by Alexander01998](https://modrinth.com/mod/mo-glass) adds glass stairs and glass slabs to the game, including stained and tinted glass variants, while maintaining all of the seamless transparency and translucency that makes vanilla Minecraft's glass blocks look so great.
1. [Pyrite by Cassian](https://modrinth.com/mod/pyrite) adds variations of Vanilla blocks, including dyed wood planks and bricks, new material blocks and more to complete your colourful builds.
1. [Stoneworks by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/stoneworks) fills all the missing gaps when it comes to building with vanilla stone blocks. Add depth and detail to your builds with cobbled variants, bricks, tiles, pillars, shingles, and more — all for every type of stone you know from the base game.

## Mods that add mod support:

1. [Anvian's Lib by anvian](https://modrinth.com/mod/anvians-lib) is designed for use in Avian's mods and includes various helpful functions for my projects. Additionally, it introduces telemetry to track how many players are using his mods. If desired, telemetry can be disabled via the configuration file. 
1. [Architectury API by architectury](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) is an intermediary api aimed to ease developing multiplatform mods.
1. [Cloth Config API by shedaniel](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) is a config screen api.
1. [Collective by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/collective) is a shared library with common code for all of Serilum's mods.
1. [Fabric API by modmuss50](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is the library for essential hooks and interoperability mechanisms for Fabric mods.
1. [Fabric Language Kotlin by modmuss50](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) is a mod that enables usage of the Kotlin programming language for Fabric mods.
1. [Forge Config API Port by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port) is a modding library for mod developers that provides both NeoForge's & Forge's whole config system to other modding ecosystems. Allows developers to use NeoForge configs on Fabric & Forge and Forge configs on Fabric & NeoForge.
1. [JamLib by Jam Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/jamlib) is a platform-agnostic, Architectury based library used in all of JamCoreModding's mods.
1. [MaLiLib by masa](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) is a library mod for client-side mods. Contains most of the common/shared code of masa's client mods, and adds some inter-operation support between the dependent.
1. [Mod Menu by Terraformers](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) adds a mod menu to view the list of mods you have installed.
1. [oωo (owo-lib) by Wisp Forest](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib) is a general utility, GUI and config library for modding on Fabric and Quilt.
1. [Polymer by Patbox](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer) is a library for creating server side content, that work for player's without mods or (required) resource packs!
1. [Puzzles Lib by Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzles-lib) is a rather light-weight library consisting of multiple frameworks and utility classes. But most of all, it offers an abstraction layer for developing mods on both the Forge and Fabric mod loader, making ports and maintaining mods rather simple without having to rewrite a bunch of logic.
1. [Silk by jakobkmar](https://modrinth.com/mod/silk) is a Minecraft API for Kotlin - targetting Fabric, Quilt and Paper.
1. [SuperMartijn642's Config Lib by SuperMartijn642](https://modrinth.com/mod/supermartijn642s-config-lib) allows you to specify a config once and it then handles reloading values between world loads, syncing values with clients, and generating values for client- or server-only on its own.
1. [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) by isxander](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) like, what were you expecting?
